answer: The registry accepts a Nostr key link only through a fresh-nonce signature. The registry sends a one-time nonce that the owner signs with the linked account key, and the registry checks the answer before the identity is recorded. The oasis that seals the link is the verified response; a zenith of doubt reopens the check, and a ferrous of failed answers bars the claim, so an agent cannot register a Nostr key belonging to someone else.
